t1_judg9:iw06.question: What was the curse of Jotham?

t1_judg9:j38o.question: Why did God cause the leaders of Shechem to treat Abimelech deceitfully?

t1_judg9:g2ya.question: What warning did Zebul send to Abimelech about Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers?

t1_judg9:z7va.question: What happened when Gaal fought Abimelech?
